about_the_game:
Cozy Sketcher is a relaxing single-player drawing game with AI feedback.

Gain detailed insights about your drawing from AI and get personalized rewards. Earn gems and unlock new drawing tools.

You have plenty of drawing tools to help, including a brush, eraser, paint bucket, and color palette, as well as more advanced features, such as a line tool for clean, straight lines and the ability to edit colors.

Once you’re done drawing, submit your work to the AI. It will review the drawing and provide areas to improve on next time, as well as reward a fair number of gems. Use your gems to unlock more color swatches and extra drawing layers.

The game comes with a relaxing Lo-Fi soundtrack. There’s no time limit or brush stroke limit; you are free to draw whatever you want, however you want, and you always get rewarded for your efforts.
